text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Toronto and East York Council to introduce overnight on-street permit parking on Rowanwood Avenue, between Yonge Street and the south branch of Cluny Drive, on a street name basis, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Rowanwood Avenue to accommodate their long term parking needs without being subject to tagging by Parking Enforcement Officers.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the amendment of Schedule A of City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate the south side of Rowanwood Avenue, between Yonge Street and the south branch of Cluny Drive, on a street name basis, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week. 2. Amended the parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Rowanwood Avenue, between Yonge Street and Thornwood Road, to be in effect from Cluny Drive (south leg) to Thornwood Road.
